notes: Nighttime selfie of Eliezer Yudkowsky (hat, beard, glasses), Sam Altman (center, curly hair), and Grimes (blonde hair, right). Rare candid moment between AI safety critic and AI company CEO.
Palmer Luckey seated in colorful Hawaiian shirt, sunglasses, gray shorts. Casual interview setting with plants and framed photos.
Palmer Luckey standing next to yellow Honda S2000 with Gran Turismo branding, Mt. Fuji in background. Stunning composition, Japanese license plate. Very aesthetic.
Iconic B&W photo of Carl Sagan holding the Pioneer plaque. Wearing dark coat and gloves. One of the most famous science communication images ever.

setting: party/club with laser lights and crowd
notes: Mark Zuckerberg selfie at a party with green laser dots, people raising hands behind him. Chain necklace, curly hair. Fun candid party energy.
David Sacks in 18th-century French aristocrat costume with Snoop Dogg in sparkly outfit, flanked by two women in period dresses. Legendary Silicon Valley party photo.
B&W photo of young Steve Jobs wearing NeXT turtleneck, talking to someone at an event. Rare early photo from the NeXT era.

setting: office/conference room with Saturn V model
notes: Wernher von Braun seated at desk with Saturn V rocket model beside him, wearing suit. Wood-paneled office. Iconic aerospace pioneer portrait.

setting: indoor room with anime figurine collection shelves
notes: Palmer Luckey sitting cross-legged on floor playing a green Game Boy, Hawaiian shirt, flip-flops, massive anime figurine collection on glass shelves behind him. Peak otaku energy.
B&W portrait of Erwin Schrödinger outdoors wearing round glasses, knit sweater, tie, and overcoat. Trees and water in background. Distinguished academic look.

setting: San Francisco Bay with American flag and Alcatraz
notes: Young Elon Musk (dated 31/7/94) standing in front of American flag with Alcatraz and SF Bay visible. Rare early photo of Musk as a young immigrant. Very compelling origin story image.
Peter Thiel walking through Trump Tower lobby in blue suit, visitors desk visible with 'HAVE I.D. READY' sign. Political crossover moment captured candidly.
Young Julian Assange with long dark hair talking on a corded phone in a messy bedroom. Rare early hacker-days photo, very candid and intimate.
B&W photo of Jack Parsons standing on rocky ground in dark double-breasted trench coat, hands in pockets, looking down. Moody, mysterious aesthetic befitting the occultist rocket pioneer.

setting: in front of early computer (MANIAC/IAS machine)
notes: B&W photo of Robert Oppenheimer (left, tall, thin) and John von Neumann (right, shorter, smiling) standing in front of the IAS computer at Princeton. Legendary photo of two Manhattan Project giants with pioneering computing hardware.
B&W portrait photo of Stanisław Ulam. Formal academic portrait style.
Ross Ulbricht sitting on a beach, shirtless, casual photo. Contrast between carefree image and his later imprisonment for founding Silk Road.

B&W photo of three men on a bench at Los Alamos — Stanisław Ulam (left, suit), Richard Feynman (center, white t-shirt), and John von Neumann (right, button-down, smoking). Three intellectual titans in one casual frame.
B&W triptych of Jim Simons smoking a cigarette — left and right show full face with glasses and houndstooth blazer, center is extreme close-up of eye and cigarette. Striking artistic composition.

setting: indoor, seated on floor with Atari console and chess set
notes: Demis Hassabis seated cross-legged with Atari 2600 console, game cartridges (Breakout, River Raid), and chess board. Perfect visual metaphor for DeepMind's journey from game AI to general intelligence.
Jim Simons in dark suit and red tie with a red ruffed lemur sitting on his shoulder. Eccentric billionaire energy. City skyline visible through window behind.
